name: Ivan Horvat
bio:
Ivan Horvat's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for engines. Growing up in a small village near Zagreb, he spent countless hours tinkering with old motorcycles and cars. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he apprenticed at a local machining shop, honing his skills in precision metalwork. After years of working in the automotive industry, Ivan finally realized his dream by joining Brad Jones Racing. 

Known for his meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving abilities, Ivan approaches every task with unwavering dedication. He believes that even the smallest component can make a significant difference in performance, pushing him to strive for perfection in every aspect of his work. His colleagues often seek his advice on complex technical challenges. Ivan is a valuable asset to the team, known for his reliability and commitment to excellence. 

Ivan is also known for his ability to adapt and innovate, always seeking out new techniques and materials to improve the performance and reliability of the team's race cars. His unique blend of traditional machining skills and modern engineering knowledge makes him a distinctive and indispensable member of the Brad Jones Racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ivan is a man of medium build, with strong hands that bear the marks of his trade.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting any task.
Has a habit of humming classical music while working on intricate parts.
Insists on cleaning his tools meticulously at the end of each day, no matter how late it is.
